question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 2.
solution:
The correct answer is option 4) i.e., 'the'.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• In the given blank we need to use an **article** that would describe the following **noun principal.**
 
• Thus, the definite article the is correct for the given blank. 
 
• So, option 4 is the correct answer. 

So the correct passage would be:- *Lin Piao used to absent himself (1) from classes very often and one day **(2) the** principal of the college made up his (3)________ to expel him. So he sent for the (4)_______ man. Lin arrived just (5)___________ the principal was about to go for lunch. "Is this the time to come?" said the principal, sternly.*

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** 

 
• The **definite article** is used before singular and plural nouns when the noun is specific or particular.
 
• **The** signals that the noun is definite, that it refers to a particular member of a group.
